supporting_quotes.exact: The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.

observation.object: a pipeline converting requests for frame captures into frames on a 1:1 basis

supporting_quotes.exact: Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).

claims.rationale: claim 的两个断言均与引文逐句对应：Android 8.0 引入 Treble 并将 Camera HAL API 切到 HIDL 定义的稳定接口；从 Android 13 起 camera HAL 接口开发使用 AIDL。引文原句即支持两段表述，无相反或缺失内容。

observation.subject: camera HAL interface
observation.object: AIDL from Android 13; HIDL from Android 8.0 Treble

supporting_quotes.exact: The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework and defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware.
Android's camera hardware abstraction layer (HAL) connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: camera driver and higher-level Android framework, defining an interface for apps to operate camera hardware

observations.subject: camera HAL
observations.object: higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to underlying camera driver and hardware

claims.rationale: 两条引文合起来完整支持 claim 的双向定位：第一条给出 HAL 位于 camera driver 与更高层 Android framework 之间且定义必须实现的接口；第二条确认 HAL 向上连接 Camera 2 的更高层框架 API、向下连接 camera driver 与硬件。两条引文分别覆盖 claim 的接口位置与上/下连接两个维度，一致无冲突。

observation.subject: HAL
observation.object: driver and higher-level framework; connects Camera 2 APIs to driver and hardware

supporting_quotes.exact: Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction. The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app allowing for interaction with HAL-integrated multi-camera features.

observations.subject: logical camera device
observations.object: composed of two or more physical cameras in the same direction, exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

claims.rationale: 引文逐项对应 claim 全部要素：Android 9 引入多摄像头 API 支持；逻辑摄像头设备由两个或多个同方向物理摄像头组成；对应用呈现为单个 CameraDevice/CaptureSession。claim 与引文完全一致。

observation.subject: logical camera device
observation.object: two or more same-direction physical cameras exposed as single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

supporting_quotes.exact: Most of this information is a static property of the camera subsystem and can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests.

the new camera API adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame. This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture, as well as additional per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output.
For most settings, the expectation is that they can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream.

observations.object: a static property of the camera subsystem queryable before configuring output pipelines or submitting requests

observations.object: every frame without significant stutter or delay

claims.rationale: 三条引文分别对应 claim 的三个分类：(1) evidence-ec5493ad2bf0 支持 static 类——相机子系统静态属性、可在配置输出管线或提交请求前查询；(2) evidence-ccd5ac3651b7 支持 dynamic 类——随每帧产生、含实际使用参数与时间戳等元数据；(3) evidence-5fc4b7551293 支持 control 类——多数设置预期可每帧修改且不明显引入卡顿或延迟。三条来源相同但分别覆盖 claim 的不同方面，结论一致。

observation.object: static (queryable before pipelines/requests), dynamic (per-frame params and timestamps), control (changeable per frame)

supporting_quotes.exact: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement. A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.
HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: a standard-interface abstraction layer allowing vendors to implement lower-level device-specific features without affecting higher-level code

observations.subject: HIDL
observations.object: communication between HAL clients and HAL services

claims.rationale: 第一条引文完整支持 HAL 定义（标准接口、厂商实现、实现底层设备特定功能而不影响更高层代码）；第二条引文支持 HIDL 用于 HAL client 与 HAL service 之间通信。引文与 claim 中两段内容一一对应，一致无矛盾。

observation.subject: HAL/HIDL
observation.object: vendor-facing standard abstraction layer; HIDL for client-service communication

observations.object: most of them GTest-style tests checking the HAL implementation

claims.rationale: claim（VTS 中大多数测试为检查 HAL 实现的 GTest 风格测试）与引文逐字对应，不存在转述失准或添加内容。

observation.object: mostly GTest-style tests checking the HAL implementation

supporting_quotes.exact: hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.

An entity is a basic media hardware building block. It can correspond to a large variety of logical blocks such as physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors.

observations.subject: hardware devices
observations.object: an oriented graph of entities connected through pads

observations.subject: entity
observations.object: a basic media hardware building block that can correspond to CMOS sensor, SoC image processing pipeline block, DMA channels or physical connectors

claims.rationale: 两条引文共同支持 claim：第一条说明硬件设备被建模为通过 pad 连接的 entity 有向图；第二条给出 entity 定义（基本媒体硬件构建块）及可对应对象（CMOS sensor、SoC 图像处理流水线构建块、DMA 通道、连接器）。claim 中所有要素（media controller 图模型、pad 连接、entity 定义及示例）均获支持，一致无冲突。

observation.subject: media framework / entity
observation.object: oriented graph of entities connected through pads; entity = basic media hardware building block (CMOS sensor, SoC pipeline, DMA, connectors)
